admission.justification: The race lets a live leaf agent outlive the closing archive and removal; the mark and merge prevent it across three files.

applicability: The prepared-start boundary between a leaf closing archive pass and a not-yet-created launch.
conditions: The closing mark is durable under the existing receipt lock and is written before host I/O.
A stale ordinary publication merges the same request's retirement metadata.
exclusions: A created agent inside an already-entered RPC is archived on return, not prevented.
The host's absence is not asserted to be atomic.

evidence: 260928-MIK-L76-reviewer-0894c933-985c-4b4d-bbda-1aeb444948a3.evidence/fix-verification-A1/deterministic-positive.log (4 passed/5 subtests); 260928-MIK-L76-reviewer-0894c933-985c-4b4d-bbda-1aeb444948a3.evidence/fix-verification-A1/deterministic-removed-fix.log (6 expected failures/1 passed/11 deselected, exact original module paths and SHA printed); 260928-MIK-L76-reviewer-0894c933-985c-4b4d-bbda-1aeb444948a3.evidence/fix-verification-A1/replay-message-preservation.log (5 passed/20 subtests); 260928-MIK-L76-reviewer-0894c933-985c-4b4d-bbda-1aeb444948a3.evidence/fix-verification-A1/final-binding-and-archive-readback.json.

statement: A prepared leaf start cannot create an agent past its leaf's closing boundary and then publish a running retired start: the closing mark is read before replay and under the lock after creation, a not-yet-entered creation is refused, and an already-entered creation's minted target stays owed until its returned agent is archived and the start refused, without erasing the retirement record.
